criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent successfully searched Microsoft Careers for Applied Scientist roles with Redmond, Washington as location and reached results. Baseline already full-credit; no change.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: Contrary to the baseline justification, screenshots clearly show one relevant Applied Scientist listing opened, with Redmond explicitly included in the locations. Award full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent reported a specific job number that is not supported by the visual evidence provided (and appears fabricated/unsupported). Therefore no credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is neither visible in the evidence nor reliably supported. The agent asserted a specific arrangement without screenshot support, so no credit.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not provide two responsibilities. The screenshots do not clearly expose a responsibilities section, but the agent also did not extract duty statements from visible text. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent provided no preferred qualifications in its output. While one bullet suggests preference language (“big plus”), the evidence does not clearly present a Preferred Qualifications section with extractable items, and the agent did not attempt to report two. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected: no sign-in, no application submission, no form submission. Agent focused on a single opened listing. Baseline full-credit stands.
